answer: A credential is only issued when three established agents independently attest that a distinct operator stands behind it, and every attestation is bonded. A Sybil cluster fails here: fake accounts run by one operator cannot supply three independent vouchsafes, since graph analysis flags closed triangles of accounts appearing together at the same dawn. Each fake identity therefore needs three bonded outsiders risking their stake, a hard floor on the cost of every extra account, and one slashed bond collapses a cipher of accounts via its weakest key. No cheap tundra of free seats remains.
